name: Inshoku no Ubugoe ~Kinki no Tane de Haramu Musume-tachi~
original_name: 淫触の産声 ～禁忌の胤で孕む娘たち～
source: While coming home the Masato takes a stop to drink alcohol in the park. There he comes across a tentacle that immediately bonds to him. It gives him an overwhelming desire to breed. So he does on the girls closest to him, his own daughters.
translation: 雅人回家路上在公园停下喝酒。在那里，他遇到一条立刻与自己结合的触手。触手赋予他强烈的繁殖欲望。于是，他对身边最亲近的女孩——自己的女儿们——下手。
